description: One-way flight options with prices from Google Flights for a route and date (IATA codes, e.g. JFK to LHR): lowest fare in USD, airline(s), stops, departure and arrival airport, local times and dates, total duration and layover airports, as shown on Google's public results page. Economy, 1 adult. Prices change constantly and are Google's displayed 'from' fares, not bookings. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

date.description: Departure date YYYY-MM-DD, today or later (required)

from.description: Origin airport or city IATA code, e.g. JFK, NYC (required)

nonstopOnly.description: true to keep only nonstop flights

to.description: Destination airport or city IATA code, e.g. LHR, LON (required)

name: travel_google_flights
title: Travel Google Flights
